summary: Ran the complete requested-feature API regression suite and teacher/student browser flows. All 10 backend tests passed, including upload validation, quiz answer-key protection/scoring, assignment grading, notification scoping, and role boundaries. UI material upload, student download, quiz scoring, assignment submission, and notification rendering worked, with assignment status/grade feedback presentation defects found.

ui_bugs.issue: The shared result state is not cleared on navigation. After a student downloads a material and navigates to Assignments, the page displays the stale 'Download ready' message; the assignment submit test can falsely observe this old success state.

After successful assignment upload, the page only shows a transient message and does not render the submitted status or submitted filename from the API response, despite the workspace promising status visibility.

integration_issues.issue: Grade PATCH succeeds and persists the score/status, but the Grade Reports branch does not render teacher-success-message and does not display saved feedback, quiz score, or final 60/40 score. Browser wait for grading confirmation timed out even though the API result was successful.

action_items: Clear or scope StudentWorkspace result state when changing pages, and render a dedicated assignment-submitted status from the submission response.
After grading, render a success state plus saved score, feedback, quiz score, and final score in Grade Reports; refresh or update the submission row.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentWorkspace reuses one result state across Subjects and Assignments, allowing stale success text to masquerade as a newly completed submission.
TeacherWorkspace Grade Reports performs a PATCH but has no success rendering or final-score fields in that branch, so persisted grading data is not observable to the teacher.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core teacher/student flows pass; assignment status and grade presentation fail)

seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST material, quiz, assignment, submissions, and grading records through the requested API/browser flows; seeded records were not modified intentionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API coverage is green. Recheck student download-to-Assignments navigation, assignment submitted status after upload, and teacher Grade Reports success/final-score/feedback rendering. Existing auth, role dashboards, admin boundaries, quiz scoring, notification APIs, and mobile regression were covered in prior iteration reports.
rca of the issue: StudentWorkspace stores material-download and assignment-submit feedback in the same result state and does not reset it when page changes. Teacher Grade Reports returns from the API PATCH without setting a rendered success/result object; unlike the create-workspace branch, its JSX has no message or grading summary block.
